Name: Dwarven Drill
Author: S1mmyy
Description:
This mod adds a drill item. The drill does absolutely nothing functionally without the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6121/]Skull Cavern Drill[/url] mod.
The item itself is costly to make, whether you purchase it from the Dwarf or craft it on your own.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
